scripts.sync: cp index.html manifest.json www/ && npx cap sync
scripts.dev: npm run sync && npx browser-sync start --server www --port 3000 --host 0.0.0.0 --no-open --watch
scripts.build:android: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
